description: A dim, warmly lit recording studio. A large mixing console with rows of faders and knobs fills the centre, with a reel-to-reel tape machine behind it and studio monitors at the top left. In the foreground a low table holds a half-full wine bottle, a glass of red wine, ashtrays with cigarettes, and handwritten lyric sheets. Crumpled paper lies on the floor, and a worn leather chair sits at the right beside tangled cables. The scene is an oil-painting style with no people.
